messages.高い速度で敵との速度差を作り、速度差で全攻撃スキルを強化して戦う自己完結型の貫通: A self-sufficient Pierce attacker that uses high Speed to create Speed differences and enhance all his attack skills. S2 Engagement is his main attack.
messages.速度差で強化: 速度範囲は4〜6/4〜7/4〜8。S1「ルミーズ」は対象より2以: **Speed-difference bonuses**: His Speed range is 4–6/4–7/4–8. S1 Remise gains +1 Coin Power if he is at least 2 faster than the target. S2 and S3 gain Coin Power based on Speed difference (+1 per 2 Speed difference at higher Uptie; up to 2 for S2 and 3 for S3).
messages.S2「アンガジェマン」: 3コイン、マッチ威力3〜15/4〜16。マッチ勝利時に: **S2 — Engagement**: 3 Coins with Clash Power 3–15/4–16. +2 Poise Count on Clash Win, and +1 each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ.
messages.クイック: S1は使用時に呼吸回数2増加、Ⅰ・Ⅱコインでそれぞれ次のターンのクイ: **Haste**: S1 increases Poise Count by 2 on use, and Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each grant 1 Haste next turn, making it easier to keep a Speed difference.
messages.決闘宣布 - シンクレア: S3「コントラタック」のⅠコインで付与。付与した相手: **Declared Duel - Sinclair**: Inflicted with Coin Ⅰ of S3 Contre Attaque. In Clashes against the marked target, he gains +1 Clash Power, and landing attacks grants 1 Haste next turn (up to 4 times per turn). It disappears if applied to another target. On Clash Win, S3 spends 10 Poise Count to gain the same amount of Poise (doubled against the Declared Duel target). Also, on Clash Win, if he Clashed while being the only one targeting that slot (Single Combat), it inflicts 1 Fragile on hit (up to 2 per turn).
messages.バトルパッシブ「眠った殺気」(傲慢×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ターン終了時、: **Combat passive — Slumbering Bloodthirst (5 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn End, +2 maximum Speed next turn per 5 Poise Count, up to 6. If all allies are faster than every enemy at Combat Start, he gains 1 Pierce DMG Up.
messages.速度差を保ったままS2を主力にマッチし、合間にS1でクイックを得る。単体ボスには: Clash mainly with S2 while keeping the Speed difference, gaining Haste with S1 in between. Against a single boss, applying Declared Duel early with S3 makes later Clashes and Haste gain easier. S3's Fragile is inflicted when he is the only one targeting that slot and wins the Single Combat Clash. Poise Potency offers little benefit and Poise Count builds naturally, so there is almost no need to play around Poise.
